body:
Follow-up to request 7d3c60f6; result 5a1ac3b2 diagnostic failed before reproducing the GUI focus path. A composed test c39697c4 as 0e64a277; focused 34 tests/1 failure/0 skips, other 33 controls passed. Evidence main 0158d95e: tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/evidence/2026-09-28/focus-0e64a277-red/. All 8,384 source entries, four FFI artifacts and fixture unchanged. Inspect run.log and responder-native-AX.txt. Hosted responder is KeyViewProxy; after-name-Tab is _SystemTextFieldFieldEditor. fullKeyboardAccess=true; native tree exposes no Load LUT AX identifier, all printed native AX IDs empty and focused false. New redundant ?? warning also needs correction, not suppression.

Prepare a separate test/diagnostic-only refinement from 01242fa4. Do not implement an NSButton-only or blanket-host production guard from this evidence. The actual GUI sequence remains Name field -> Tab -> AX-focused Load 3D LUT -> Tab hides panels, preserved on main e04fce18. The test must not assume SwiftUI semantic accessibility elements correspond to NSView nodes, and selectNextKeyView alone did not establish the observed focus. Use supported public semantic/accessibility APIs with bounded traversal/cycle detection and real native event/focus processing, or propose a strictly scoped opt-in focus trace in the actual owned app if a faithful hosted diagnostic cannot be constructed. Record native responder plus semantic focused element/role at the same actual event boundary; no private implementation-class matching, forced button focus, global settings changes or fixed sleeps. Preserve honest failure/skip reporting, viewport Tab/Space negative controls and existing shared-owner isolation. No diagnostic should open the LUT chooser or mutate user files.

Publish source hashes and precise A-only runtime plan. No B compiler/tests/apps/GPU, heartbeat/writer changes, old-candidate edits or main merge. A runtime currently released pending source review of cache instrumentation. Request is source-only; all diagnostic runtime remains A-owned.
